Enjoy this Broadway hybrid that is tuneful and poetical: A most delightful model of a modern operettical.
Still, it is easy enough to put aside almost all quibbles about genre tensions or adaptation choices because the production is so joyous and well-executed.
Though jolly enough, the latest Broadway incarnation... has a sweaty quality, bordering on frenzy, that's hopelessly at odds with the cool wit of the original.
Thoughtfully and lovingly updated for a modern audience, there's something for everyone in this production.
The finished product is operetta as political compromise, in which everyone gets a little taste of what they want, but never enough to be truly satisfied.
For Pierce's fans, it's probably unmissable, but a clearer vision would make a better, more coherent night out.
